items.name: Mana Potion
items.break_description: A compact violet-and-cyan potion shatter: small glass fragments, magical liquid splash, and a restrained energy release centered on the bottle.

items.name: Healing Elixir
items.break_description: A compact warm-gold healing elixir shatter: small glass fragments, glowing liquid droplets, and a restrained restorative burst centered on the bottle.

items.name: Arcane Crystal
items.orbit_description: A thin broken ring of tiny violet and cyan magical particles orbiting a central crystal-shaped empty space, with generous transparency between particles.

items.name: Spell Tome
items.open_description: The covers are open around the original spine and reveal two parchment pages with the same violet clasp, cyan rune light, and dark-purple binding details.

items.name: Alchemist Flask
items.reaction_description: A few tiny cyan, violet, and warm-gold alchemical bubbles and sparks concentrated tightly around the liquid region, suitable for an unstable reaction loop.

items.name: Ritual Candle
items.smoke_description: A small delicate curl of pale violet-gray pixel smoke rising from a candle wick, sparse and narrow with generous transparent space.

items.name: Enchanted Wand
items.release_description: A compact cyan-and-violet magical spark burst emitted from the wand tip, with a bright core, short rays, and a few tiny particles.
